site.name: CSS & JS Minifier
site.description: Minify CSS and JavaScript inside VS Code, locally and offline, with LightningCSS and oxc-minify.

hero.title: Minify CSS and JavaScript without leaving VS Code.
hero.lede: Two Rust-based engines, LightningCSS for CSS and oxc-minify for JavaScript, run locally with no network and no API keys. Minify a file, save a .min copy, or minify on save.

features.title: Rust-based minification
features.text: CSS goes through LightningCSS and JavaScript through oxc-minify. Both are native, so large files finish quickly.

features.title: Your code never leaves your machine
features.text: Minification runs locally. There is no network request, no API key and no file size limit beyond your memory.

features.title: Overwrite, save a copy, or minify on save
features.text: Use the command palette or the context menu, write file.min.css next to the original, and see how many bytes you saved.

features.title: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese and Chinese
features.text: The interface follows your VS Code language, with the strings kept in per-language files.

collections.label: Docs
collections.lede: How the extension is built, tested and translated.
